notes.title: Development Update #5 New Buildings and More
notes.notes:
Development Update #5 New Buildings and More


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/fcdee9d619f8a312e06db1373c9681bc1bde5c9f.jpg"]

It has been a while since we last posted an update here on Steam. If you want to follow our game more closely please join our discord at the bottom of the page for almost daily updates. Since the last update we have been hard at work making changes to the towns and many of the 3d models. The British and Spanish towns have been largely redone.


British Towns
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/01eb060a5b3a02bd70a7fb5106a8e29d9a98e56b.jpg"]

The British houses were remodeled with new different roofs and structures that are 1-3 stories tall. We also added details in the towns such as barrels, crates and bags of flour. We think these changes have given the British towns a more unique style and also makes them more lived in.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/20ba768b23bc1b905906218ff5179aaed6509b24.jpg"]
Spanish Towns


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/42b6d51bf1bb64a277af2a367156c1e70061617f.jpg"]

The Spanish Towns have also been overhauled. We completely remodeled all of the buildings to fit more of the Spanish colonial architecture. The buildings are a mix of white, sienna, and tan colors. They have also been populated with details and red brick grounds.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/31022d52b1250c30b4017fac65579a4c8e730978.jpg"]
Code Updates


Our multiplayer code is almost completely finished in terms of movement, physics and chunking the world. The inventory system is complete and we are currently rigging animations to each item the player can hold.

notes.title: Weekly Update #4 Worldbuilding and Pathways
notes.notes:
Weekly Update #4 Worldbuilding and Pathways
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/242321e3f43c908f60bf8052c94250bd3e29a381.jpg"]

This past week and half we have been working on polishing the world, adding pathways, and working on server/client integration.


Worldbuilding
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/b422ac119a80ff50ac1835a6c8969092764cd19f.png"]

We felt the world was slightly empty so we decided to add more details. We added more detail to each island and added those pathways.


Pathways
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/86cafa6155e99d4e36e4ca3e171a96cc9e089582.jpg"]

Pathways will serve to connect the loot-zones together. This will funnel players towards the paths where they can find loot and travel the island. Along the path's the player can find abandoned wares and campsites.


Server Code
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/e504fb928c1fa8813e2f44a4729e13813a00529f.jpg"]

We are in the processing of connecting the server to the client. This includes physics, movement and the inventory system. Ideally at the end of this week the dev team will be able to play together with our new server software which can support up to 250 people.

notes.title: Weekly Update #3 Stone Buildings and World Changes
notes.notes:
Weekly Update #3 Stone Buildings and World Changes


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/7a8060e7399cd6d4e5631c34d1b4ffad46dd5bf5.jpg"]

More progress this week! We decided to add stone building structures to give players another way to upgrade their base. Paths are also slowly being added to connect lootzones on the islands. Lastly we have been working on making the forts which player's can raid more menacing.


Stone Structures
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/a5a9464f44ebfc12c23cda579d2f0cd356586737.jpg"]

We added stone walls, stone triangles, stone floors, stone ceilings, reinforced doors, and wooden roofs. All of these except the wood roof will serve as building upgrades to player buildable houses. 


Paths between Loot zones
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/c5799c293c16369f08c4163f923ab7f7276e0e2d.jpg"]

These paths with connect loot zones on most islands. This will function to connect the islands so players have more defined ways to move around. Also the loot zones felt "lonely" not being connected. The hope is that these paths with also funnel player interaction.


Forts
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/1ec179020d29dcea48393df1ea7f5e816fdab12a.jpg"]

Just working on making them look larger and grander.


Server Updates
Our server architect is almost complete connect the server to the client. Soon we will have joinable servers on our new server software supporting 250 players+. The last server software was incapable of supporting our intended player count per server.

notes.title: Weekly Update #2 Caves and Skeletons
notes.notes:
Weekly Development Update #2
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/90b5760875c77c67d30de0318213e3d896bad9a2.jpg"]

This weeks development update will be shorter than previous. Our efforts have been focused on server code but we did add other visual assets. Our 3d Modeler has added caves and skeletons. 
Caves
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/6956c0f9e6277e4b8fc608b5263a9b6619ccd3a3.jpg"]

We implemented caves to the main world, which can be found on the westward chain of islands. These caves will hold gold ore for players to farm. Loot such as weapons. blueprints, and resources can be found inside. The caves will also have the same skeletons that spawn on skull island.


Skeletons
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/430745891630e78cd014f176f01a35c08678208c.png"]

Skeletons will function as another faction similar to the Redcoats or Spanish. They will occur within caves and on Skull island. Their attire shows they were former British Redcoats. Due to their anatomy and them being completely bone, bullets may not work well.


Server Code
Our server architect has continued to work without sleep to finish the server side physics. This has led to the completion of mapping the terrain so our physics controller collides with the terrain. This was the last of the server side physics. This means we can now work on other core game features such as resource collection and projectile systems.

notes.title: Weekly Update #1 Skull Island and Server code
notes.notes:
Weekly Development Update #1
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/52a92ca40199c0aeb2be37668f763dc15962b1dd.png"]

Welcome to our first weekly Sails update! Thank you for all the initial support since launching our Wishlist page. We genuinely appreciate it and hope you will enjoy the ride as we continue to develop this game. This weeks topics include Skull Island, Server code updates, Main Menu changes and other small adjustments. 
Skull Island 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/3f249b65ae9ced3c64b9bae9e8a208eeb7e721df.png"]

Our 3D modeler and worldbuilder has been hard at work creating Skull Island. This island is located far from the rest of the world and isolated. Here players will encounter a medium sized island shrouded in smoke from the island's volcano. This entire island is a loot-zone(area in which players can find gear, recipes and resources) which means players will encounter rare enemies and unique loot. There is abandoned towns and also an ominous lighthouse shackled to the island.


Server Code
Our server architect has been working tirelessly on implementing the kinematic player controller to the server. This requires us to create our own custom physics system to allow large worlds with shifting origins. When we started coding Sails we decided to write our own server software which has been no easy task. This makes development times take longer but improves performance and more potential customization down the road.


Main Menu
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653081/daf7da7a0af9c7cea6651b194e651c747cb8b25b.png"]

Our level designer has completely overhauled the main menu. Changed the environment and color grading of the world. The main menu will have a camera that flies around the island similar to early 2000s Xbox games. Let us know what you think of it.
